pages.text: The Miniature Matrix Terminal collects scattered machines into one 5x5x5 hollow box: chips mounted on the walls serve as the library and the power source, supplying machines across the air.$(br2)$(bold)Formation:$(reset)$(li)Build a sealed 5x5x5 cavity with Miniature Matrix Casings (structure glass can replace casings as a window)$(li)Mount the Miniature Matrix Terminal itself on the wall; the controller must be on a wall$(li)Place the five Mini Matrix upgrade components in the cavity and leave everything else empty$(br2)An unsealed box does not function; breaking any wall block disables it immediately, aborting any running craft and returning the locked materials.

$(bold)Mounting chips on the walls:$(reset) a Miniature Terminal that already holds data, placed on the wall, is recognized by the matrix; the matrix reads its item library and red energy readouts. That chip's library becomes the matrix's library and its energy becomes the matrix's energy pool.$(br2)$(li)More capacity or energy: mount additional chips$(li)With no chip present, crafting reports that no usable item terminal chip is on the walls$(li)Security settings are registered once on the matrix and then pushed to every bound chip; sneak-right-click the terminal to push manually$(br2)A chip is a data-carrying Miniature Terminal; a higher-quality terminal provides a larger library and more energy.

$(bold)The five cavity upgrade components (effective only inside the cavity, not on the walls):$(reset)$(li)Wireless Control Component ×1: controls machines inside the field network; the target machine requires the Wireless Receiver Upgrade$(li)Wireless Field Upgrade, up to 3: projects and powers the translucent blue field barrier, +1 chunk radius each$(li)Wireless Expansion Upgrade, up to 3: each adds one Wireless Network Node claim slot; nodes placed inside the field project their own 1-chunk sub-field (requires chunk-loading support)$(li)Wireless Crafting Upgrade ×1: the terminal's Craft page lists craftable items and schedules crafting by recipe (time, red energy and IP)$(li)Wireless Field Link Upgrade ×1: feeds red energy, life energy and IP directly to machines inside the field (IP only for crafting)$(br2)Additional copies of a component raise its level up to the caps above; the Chips page shows the current counts, and a broken structure disables them immediately.$(br2)For high-power machines with an energy pool, power is supplied on demand: a machine draws energy only while it can actually process, and an idle machine draws nothing.

Reading order: the universal layout rules in $(l:akaishi:matrix)Matrix Structures$(/l) first, then configure cards and security in $(l:akaishi:wireless)Wireless Energy$(/l); bulk materials can be supplied through $(l:akaishi:item_pipe)Item Pipes$(/l).
